summary: The new file re-derives, specialized to Gegenbauer, the whole TauCeti weighted-orthogonal-basis pipeline (orthonormality, span transfer, monomial-moment vanishing, completeness, assembly), which is directly instantiable here because `gegenbauerThreeHalvesMeasure` is literally `(volume.restrict (Ioc (-1) 1)).withDensity (ENNReal.ofReal ∘ (1 - x²))`.
